rows.label: qst620203_msg0001
rows.name: Good. We're all here.

rows.label: qst620203_msg0002
rows.name: Does anyone have anything to report?

rows.label: qst620203_msg0003
rows.name:
I defeated every monster on Iyasaki
Island, Unin Island, at Ansel Breeding
Ground, and at Port Isheba.

rows.label: qst620203_msg0004
rows.name:
I don't think anyone asked
you to go quite that far...

rows.label: qst620203_msg0005
rows.name:
Perhaps, but at least no more harm
will befall the village's fields.

rows.label: qst620203_msg0006
rows.name: Guren, how about you?

rows.label: qst620203_msg0007
rows.name:
I had a passionate talk with everyone
in Iyasaki Village!

rows.label: qst620203_msg0008
rows.name:
Weren't you supposed to be asking
about eyewitness accounts...?

rows.label: qst620203_msg0009
rows.name:
You could put it that way... But the
result is clear!

rows.label: qst620203_msg0010
rows.name:
There is not a single bad person in
this village! Everyone is good!

rows.label: qst620203_msg0011
rows.name:
But, uh, people have been known
to conceal their true selves.

rows.label: qst620203_msg0012
rows.name:
Even in a small settlement, there must
be at least one bad person.

rows.label: qst620203_msg0013
rows.name:
No vegetables were actually stolen
from the field, right? Nobody here
would steal!

rows.label: qst620203_msg0014
rows.name:
Also, nobody's seen anything
suspicious, either!!!

rows.label: qst620203_msg0015
rows.name:
Hmph. Keep your emotions in check.
Stay calm, as Tokiha does.

rows.label: qst620203_msg0016
rows.name: ...Tch.

rows.label: qst620203_msg0017
rows.name: Well, what about you, Tokiha?

rows.label: qst620203_msg0018
rows.name:
I kept watch over the field all night
without sleeping.

rows.label: qst620203_msg0019
rows.name:
Tokiha, you still like doing things
that feel like punishment games.

rows.label: qst620203_msg0020
rows.name:
Grr... But perhaps thanks to that, no
vegetables were stolen.

rows.label: qst620203_msg0021
rows.name:
No. Your watch was pointless, since I
had already defeated the monsters.

rows.label: qst620203_msg0022
rows.name:
No, no! Nothing was stolen because I
had passionate talks with the
villagers!!

rows.label: qst620203_msg0023
rows.name:
I don't think so... They probably
stayed away because I kept watch all
night.

rows.label: qst620203_msg0024
rows.name: That's not true!

rows.label: qst620203_msg0025
rows.name: ...Driver, what do you think?

rows.label: qst620203_msg0026
rows.name:
Who of us has done the best
job? Listen to your heart
and answer honestly!

rows.label: qst620203_msg0027
rows.name: Who has done the best job?

rows.label: qst620203_msg0028
rows.name: Vasara

rows.label: qst620203_msg0029
rows.name: Guren

rows.label: qst620203_msg0030
rows.name: Tokiha

rows.label: qst620203_msg0031
rows.name: Ha. An obvious choice.

rows.label: qst620203_msg0032
rows.name:
Wooooah! That is what I wanted to
hear!!

rows.label: qst620203_msg0033
rows.name:
I'm honored. It's good to know my
efforts have been appreciated.

rows.label: qst620203_msg0034
rows.name: Can I say something?

rows.label: qst620203_msg0035
rows.name: I have something to say too.

rows.label: qst620203_msg0036
rows.name: I was saying...

rows.label: qst620203_msg0037
rows.name: Aiiieeeeeee!!!

rows.label: qst620203_msg0038
rows.name:
I see... Looks like this is the
vegetable thief.

rows.label: qst620203_msg0039
rows.name:
So it came out of the Cloud Sea
because it was hungry.

rows.label: qst620203_msg0040
rows.name:
...Hang on a moment! Vasara,
didn't you say you'd wiped out
all the monsters nearby?!

rows.label: qst620203_msg0041
rows.name:
I'm no Salvager. Creatures living in
the Cloud Sea were outside the target.

rows.label: qst620203_msg0042
rows.name:
And yourself, did you not say you
would question the villagers?

rows.label: qst620203_msg0043
rows.name:
Could something this big really steal
vegetables without anyone seeing it?

rows.label: qst620203_msg0044
rows.name:
Enough bickering, you two. Let us
defeat it!

rows.label: qst620203_msg0045
rows.name: Yeah! Let us do it!!
